summary: Enhance your skills with our Nutrition in Emergencies Training Course. Learn essential strategies to provide effective nutritional support in crisis situations.
lede: Emergency nutrition response combines needs assessment with practical service planning for people affected by crises. Designed for nutrition officers, programme managers, health workers and monitoring specialists, the course covers rapid assessment and MUAC screening, referral mapping, infant and young child feeding support, and nutrition indicator monitoring. Learners also consider data quality, community engagement and coordination when access or supplies are constrained.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support nutrition assessment, programme delivery, community services, health operations, monitoring, and emergency coordination. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical tools for crisis nutrition work without requiring advanced epidemiology or programming experience.
prerequisites: No advanced epidemiology, statistics, or programming experience is required. You should have basic exposure to humanitarian response, community health, nutrition services, monitoring, or emergency coordination. Bring a laptop if possible for spreadsheet and KoboToolbox exercises. Coding is not required. Advanced digital analytics and AI-assisted data review are introduced at conceptual and operational application levels, not production engineering depth.
